name: Smith Machine Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Place a bench about two to three feet behind a Smith machine.
Rest the bar on your upper back and unhook it.
Put one foot forward under the bar and the other foot on the bench behind.
Lower straight down until the front thigh is about parallel.
Push through the front heel to rise. Finish the set, then switch legs.
cues: Breathe in down, breathe out as you rise

common_mistakes.mistake: Front foot too close to the bench
common_mistakes.fix: Move it forward so the shin stays upright
Let the front leg do the work
Set the stops just below your lowest point
